    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE 
    l.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status;

    COUNT(*) AS total_gold_cards,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards_before_1998,

FROM 
    card c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN 
    client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
JOIN 
    district dist ON cl.district_id = dist.district_id

    c.type = 'gold'
GROUP BY 
    dist.A3;

GROUP BY

    COUNT(*) AS school_count

    "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CAST(SPLIT(r.time, ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SPLIT(r.time, ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT(r.time, ':')[2] AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 1) || SUBSTR(r.time, 3, 1) || SUBSTR(r.time, 6, 1) AS INTEGER) * 0.001
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY 
    ra.year;

SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CAST(STR_SPLIT(r.time, ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(STR_SPLIT(r.time, ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(STR_SPLIT(r.time, ':')[2] AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 1) || SUBSTR(r.time, 3, 1) || SUBSTR(r.time, 6, 1) AS INTEGER) * 0.001
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY 
    ra.year;

SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) * 0.001
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY 
    ra.year;

       ) AS fastest_time_ms

LIMIT 5;

SELECT driverId, 
       MIN(
           CAST(SUBSTRING(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 + 
           CAST(SUBSTRING(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
       ) AS fastest_time_ms
FROM lapTimes
WHERE lap = 1
GROUP BY driverId
ORDER BY fastest_time_ms
LIMIT 5;

SELECT driverId, 
       MIN(
           CAST(SUBSTRING(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 + 
           CAST(SUBSTRING(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, IF(INSTR(time, '.') > 0, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1, LENGTH(time) - INSTR(time, ':')) ) AS INTEGER) * 1000 + 
           IF(INSTR(time, '.') > 0, CAST(SUBSTRING(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER), 0)
       ) AS fastest_time_ms
FROM lapTimes
